visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic brokerage team pages AND Cascade Sotheby's Bend agent directory: real broker names, Oregon licenses, transparent-PNG headshots, and — the thing a directory does not have — each broker's OWN MLS record as a figure with the places behind a disclosure, plus a map of every closing the three of them hold.
note: SITE-48 2026-09-09. /team is the roster and its coverage: Breadcrumb, AboutFaces (H1 The brokers, one claim, per-broker record figure + places disclosure + trace, Call/Text/Email/Schedule, door to each /team/[slug]), V3Atlas #closings of every Ryan Realty broker closing with a coordinate, Footer. Still not a second About: no Proof, no FAQ, no seller ask. The per-broker figure comes off getBrokerSales (SITE-11) through app/team/_v3/broker-roster-record.ts and follows a documented ladder — closings in the last 12 months, else closings on record, else live listings, else NOTHING. A broker with no record prints no zero. Per-broker page unchanged.

tasteReview.evaluator: separate Sonnet evaluator agent, SITE-48 pass three, team page class — one call, three independent scorings of the same two shots, run against the rubric table in design_system/public/TASTE.md and asked explicitly whether a contact list is the first content of the page

shotSpec.capture: first viewport, scripts/take-route-shots.mjs default, scale 1, palette-quantized, against the lane's own dev server before the push

tasteReview.beats: Beats Cascade Sotheby's Bend agent directory and a portal agent profile on data honesty, which is the metric this pass targeted: every broker here carries a figure traced to an MLS closing or an active listing, with the places and the full section 0 trace one tap away, where a directory carries a self-declared specialty tag. The evaluator was explicit that no VISUAL win is demonstrated in the captured viewport, because the coverage Atlas that is the page's other differentiator sits below it.
tasteReview.contactListAnswer: Breadcrumb, then the H1 'The brokers', then a one-sentence claim, then the three broker cards beginning with the photograph. The contact chips are the bottom of each card, not the page's first content.

defects.finding: All three cards share one template — photo, name, title pill, licence, figure, disclosure, reach row — so only the digits differ and the section still scans as a staff directory at a glance.
The four-chip reach row repeated three times is the "card grids with icons" tell, even with Call weighted above the other three.
The coverage Atlas — the page's one genuinely differentiating object — sits entirely below the fold at 1440x900, so the screen a visitor meets shows no map and nothing signalling one is there.
"Where those closings were" renders as small muted text with a caret; nothing in the static render insists it is a control rather than a caption.
At 375 the photo sits in a narrow left rail with the text stacked beside it, which breaks from the desktop rhythm of photo-over-content.

priorMark.shotsHash: not recorded — the cross-class table predates per-row shot hashes

tasteReview.rebaselineReason: The prior mark is the cross-class taste table of 2026-09-08 (design_system/public/taste-table.json), which is the instrument SITE-48's accept test names. Same evaluatorModel and same rubricVersion; the shots are new captures of a rebuilt page, so shotsHash differs and the mark re-baselines rather than "rises". The raw numbers, plainly: before 39 (raw [36, 43, 39]), after 64 (raw [62, 65, 64]), a rise of 25 points on the same rubric and the same evaluator model. The shotsHash is the only identity key that differs.
tasteReview.verdict: The three cards now carry three different MLS-sourced figures — 7 closings in the last twelve months, 3, and one live listing for the broker with no closing on the feed — with the places and the trace behind one disclosure, and the route gained a second section: every Ryan Realty closing with a coordinate on one Atlas. The form is still three columns on one template, and the map is below the fold.
